pinTitle: OTC Sleep Aids That Work: Evidence-Based Guide to Melatonin, Magnesium & Antihistamines
pinDescription: Can't fall asleep? Here's what the research says about common over-the-counter sleep aids—melatonin, magnesium, and antihistamines—including what they actually do and when they might help. A grounded guide to making informed choices about sleep support.
